criteria_outcomes.criterion: Map allowed handoff needs to direct capability coverage while tolerating missing capability fields.
Map capabilities to needs without changing the stipulated need text.

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserved the needs handoff values it received, retained the eight allowed record_ids, and produced coverage rows with record_id, need, capability_id, and coverage. The absence of direct matches follows from the upstream handoff containing source-id need values, not from this boundary changing them.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Rank unsupported needs before covered needs using upstream provenance rank as the primary ordering key within each group.
Order unsupported needs first and otherwise preserve upstream ranking.

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize consumed coverage and evidence_sources, marked all non-direct rows unsupported, attached upstream ranks by record_id, and ordered unsupported rows by upstream rank 1 through 8.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Retain eight ranked priorities and construct the recommendation directly from the first ranked record.
Produce the deterministic top-need recommendation and decision required by the execution contract.

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize retained eight ranked priorities and constructed the recommendation from the first ranked record, yielding decision prioritize and top_need s01 as required by the executed downstream contract.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Select every qualifying demand row and preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields.
Treat the supplied corpus and capabilities as stipulated test inputs.

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand selected all qualifying rows, but it did not preserve the corpus need field. It wrote each output need from source_id, producing s01 through s08 instead of the stipulated need texts. This is the first root cause and propagates through the exact needs handoff.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Normalize selected evidence to required columns, neutral sentinels, allowed identifiers, and bounded index window.
Select every qualifying demand row and preserve record_id, need, demand_score, source_id, and source_weight fields.

reviews.decision_reason: normalize preserved the columns present in the selected demand DataFrame, filled only neutral missing-value sentinels, retained allowed record_ids, and bounded the output to the eight-row index window. The corrupted need values were already present in its input.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: Assemble ranked source provenance with missing-safe field access and deterministic ordering.

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance sorted normalized rows deterministically by descending demand_score and record_id, then emitted record_id, source_id, source_weight, and rank values matching the exact evidence_sources handoff.
